subject: Re: Request: price alignment and migration assistance for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acmecloud.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: price alignment and migration assistance for Acme Cloud

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, the procurement team is asking if Redwood can match the headline unit economics our current vendor offered (they proposed a blended token rate that over the 12‑month term brings a ~22% price advantage). Before we engage legal, procurement asked for a concrete proposal that:

- shows a matched effective rate (or equivalent credits) by quarter,
- outlines any onboarding/migration credits and timing, and
- includes mitigations for runtime compatibility and SLA parity.

Can you send a short offer we can share internally? We have a decision window the week of Mar 16.

Attachments: vendor-proposal-summary.pdf (2 pages)

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Tran
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud
From: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acmecloud.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: price alignment and migration assistance for Acme Cloud

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Attached is a concise offer summary and an onboarding checklist (PDF + spreadsheet). High level:

1) Price alignment: we can deliver a blended effective rate similar to your vendor for Q1–Q4 via a combination of a transient onboarding credit + scaled volume tiers.

2) Migration/onboarding credits: one‑time migration credit equal to 15% of estimated first‑quarter consumption applied as invoice credit.

3) Runtime/SLA mitigations:
   - We’ll include a 30‑day pilot with performance SLAs measured against your existing workload (same sequence length / concurrency).
   - Fallback plan: automatic routing to a compatible quantized variant if latency exceeds threshold; documented in the attached checklist.

Please see the attached: redwood-acme-matched-offer.pdf and acme-migration-checklist.xlsx. If this looks directionally right I can loop in Solutions Engineering to run the pilot plan and draft contract language for legal.

Next step I propose: internal alignment call with Procurement + Ops on Tues (Mar 9) or Wed (Mar 10). Which works for you?

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-acme-matched-offer.pdf (3 pages), acme-migration-checklist.xlsx (workbook)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: price alignment and migration assistance for Acme Cloud

Lukas / Karthik — quick internal notes after reviewing the draft offer:  

- Credit math: the 15% one‑time credit plus the tiered per‑token pricing gets us to close but we should model a contingency bucket (2–4% extra credit) if their Q1 runs hotter than forecast. Put that in a conditional clause, not as an upfront hit.
- Pilot scope: need 3 defined KPIs (p50 latency, p95 latency, and aggregate token cost per 1M tokens) and a clear go/no‑go threshold. Solutions Eng should own the runbook deliverables.
- Legal/Procurement: redline-friendly language — propose a 60‑day acceptance period for credits if they dispute usage.

Karthik — can you confirm runtime compatibility risks for their current model family? If quantization or KV cache differences make parity unlikely within 30 days we should call that out and offer a staged fallback (pilot → extended pilot + additional credit).

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Sales Operations

Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Redwood matched offer and pilot next steps (proposal attached)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the patience while we tightened the proposal. Attached is the final matched offer (PDF) and a brief pilot runbook. Key updates from the draft:  

- Conditional contingency credit: an additional ad‑hoc credit up to 3% if Q1 consumption exceeds forecast by >10% (applies only to invoices covering the first 90 days).
- Pilot KPIs: p50 latency <= 120ms, p95 latency <= 450ms, cost per 1M tokens within 10% of baseline. Failure to meet two of three KPIs triggers an automatic 30‑day extended pilot and an additional 5% credit on the first overage invoice.
- Implementation commitment: Redwood Solutions Eng will provide an on‑site remote workshop during pilot kickoff and a dedicated engineering contact for 60 days.

Please confirm: 1) acceptance of the high‑level economics and 2) availability for the kickoff pilot meeting on Wed Mar 17 at 10:00am PT. If accepted, we’ll circulate a short SOW and DocuSign link.

Attachments: redwood-acme-matched-offer.pdf, acme-migration-checklist.xlsx

Best regards,
Lukas Meyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
